v04: A little more rain and the acacias arrive. Mulga tilts its branches upward, funneling every drop down to its roots.
v08: In the wet mountains, mountain ash, one of the tallest flowering plants on Earth, reaches for 100 meters.
v09: And where the rain barely stops, rain forest, layer upon layer on less than 1% of the land.
v11: Fifty million years ago, rain forests spread across much of Australia.
